answer: Copying the same citations across 173 aliases as a result pays the reading cost 173 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the haven check immediately, the echo audit keeps the resolved set and the vault replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission.
